title: Refactor utility functions for performance
body: This PR refactors several utility functions. Some functions still use manual for-loops and while-loops instead of modern array methods. Need to improve performance and readability.
author: bouab

comments.author: senior-dev
comments.body: The findMaximumValue function uses a while-loop which is harder to read. Consider using reduce() instead.

comments.author: tech-lead
comments.body: We should avoid manual index tracking. Array methods like map, filter and reduce are more maintainable.

comments.author: senior-dev
comments.body: Also the calculateBiggest function starts max at 0 which is a bug for arrays with all negative numbers.
